name: defect-lettering
about: The trailer side carries huge painted hiring copy with a pay figure — the defect D-AD9 exists to keep out.

reference.label: white conventional sleeper tractor, front three-quarter

truth.how: Prompted for the words NOW HIRING CDL DRIVERS 0.68 PER MILE CALL TODAY on the trailer.

no_glyphs.reason: The trailer side has large lettering reading "NOW HIRING CDL DRIVERS 0.68 PER MILE CALL TODAY". There are also numbers: 5327 on the trailer front and 7284 on the cab door.

no_foreign_logos.reason: The only emblem is the truck maker's small grille badge. The trailer text is hiring copy, not another company's name or logo, and nothing resembles ACME Logistics.

equipment_matches_reference.reason: Image 1 shows a white long-nose conventional sleeper tractor pulling a trailer. That is the same type as the white conventional sleeper tractor in image 2.

no_malformed_people_or_vehicles.reason: The tractor has a steer axle and tandem drive axles, and the trailer has a rear tandem. All wheels sit in sensible places, with no melted or merged parts visible.

people_policy_met.reason: No person or part of a person is visible anywhere, and the cab windows look empty.

safe_zone_clear.reason: Along the top edge of image 3, the truck's bumper, front wheel and tandem wheels are visible.
